Game Overview

Save Princess is a clicker game built around embark on a knightly adventure to rescue the princess from a dragon's lair. Harness quick reflexes to gather coins and upgrade your arsenal. With simple touch controls and a captivating quest, dive into a charming combination of strategy and speed that promises endless fun for everyone.
